units.text: I designed and built REST API with Python and FastAPI for partner integrations. Endpoints are versioned and there is OpenAPI specification. In 3 months 4 partners connected, no breaking changes.
I migrated 8 on-premise services to Azure with Terraform. Traffic I moved slowly with blue-green deployments. Whole move took 5 months and customers had no downtime.
I automated 15 most used user flows as end-to-end tests in Playwright. I made it so a failing test blocks the release. Weekly releases run 5 months now without rollback.
